q2_gaps: A bare appositive age ("Ray Brent Marsh, 29, ..."): Measures & units derives the scale from a stated gradable adjective ("30 years old") or a stated dimension noun ("weighs 5 kg"), and no rule licenses reading a bare appositive numeral as an age Measure, nor the unit "year" that the text never states.

An of-phrase naming the CONTENT or ground of a charge ("charges of abuse", "charges of theft"): the Complements-of-nouns test has exactly two branches - a nominalization whose underlying verb takes the of-NP as object, and a true relational noun - and "charge of X" fits neither, since one does not charge the abuse.
notes: "also" is correctly the pre-verbal VP focus with the verb-class lemma as filler, "faces" correctly takes Agent as a stative transitive with Theme charges and no status atom under simple present, and the appositive takes no tense wrapper under a present host. Minor inconsistency: bare "abuse" gets a witness while equally bare "theft" stays a constant.
